title: Patients
subtitle: Names encrypted on your computer, codes generated by the system: data stays readable only inside the practice.
emptyHint: Create the first patient: they will get an anonymous code to write down in your clinical records.
conditionsHelp: Diagnostic categories, used only to organize the work.

privacy.exportHelp: Download everything recorded about this patient as JSON (right of access and portability).
privacy.archiveHelp: An archived patient no longer appears in the list, but their data is kept.
privacy.deleteHelp: Erases the patient and all their results (right to erasure). This cannot be undone.
privacy.ownerOnly: Only the practice owner can delete a patient.
privacy.deleteConfirmText: Profile, sessions, results and raw recordings will be erased forever. The activity log will only keep a record of the deletion.

targetSuccessHelp: Difficulty adjusts automatically so the patient succeeds in about this share of trials. 75% balances challenge and motivation well.
noIdentifiers: Do not enter names, surnames, addresses or any other detail that could identify the patient.
created: Patient {code} created. Write the code down in your clinical records.
formSubtitle: Only the data needed to choose and adapt exercises.
pseudonymNotice: The patient gets an automatically generated code. If encrypted names are on, first and last names are encrypted on this computer: neither the server nor the administrator can read them.

names.unlockHelp: Enter the practice passphrase. Names are decrypted only on this computer: the server has never seen them in clear.
names.lockedText: On this device you only see codes. Enter the practice passphrase to see names too.
names.disabledText: You can store first and last names encrypted: only the practice's therapists who know the passphrase can read them, not the server nor the administrator.
names.cardHelp: First and last names are encrypted on the computer before being saved, with a key derived from a practice passphrase. Neither Supabase nor the platform administrator can read them.
names.statusLocked: On, but locked on this device.
names.statusUnlocked: On and visible on this device.
names.passphraseWarning: Keep the passphrase somewhere safe and share it only with colleagues of the practice. If it is lost, names cannot be recovered (codes and results remain).
names.passphraseRule: At least 12 characters: a phrase of several words is best, different from your sign-in password.
names.changed: Passphrase changed: every name was encrypted again
names.resetDone: Names erased: you can set a new passphrase
names.ownerOnly: Only the practice owner can turn on encrypted names.
names.resetText: Without the passphrase names cannot be decrypted. They will be erased from every patient; codes, sessions and results remain. You can then set a new passphrase and enter the names again.
names.e2eNotice: Encrypted on this computer before saving: the server and the administrator cannot read it.
names.formLocked: To add or change the name, unlock names on this device.
names.formDisabledOwner: Names are off: you can turn them on in Settings → Practice. Meanwhile the patient is identified by the code.
names.formDisabled: Names are off in this practice: the patient is identified by the code.
